Alex: quick Q — where do I find the SM% heatmap + per-pool KV cache hitrate and batch-size distribution for prod GPU fleet? Seeing a latency spike for a subset of requests and want dashboard / trace links :eyes:
Priya: Grafana has a combined view under Runtime > GPU Ops > SM + KV Cache. Try: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/3fGkL7/runtime-gpu-ops (panel IDs: SM% = 4, KV hitrate = 7, batch-size hist = 9). The panel has per-pool and per-region dropdowns. :thumbsup:
Jamal: For traces, search Tempo/Jaeger with service=gpu-runtime and span name ~"generate". Example query in Tempo: service=gpu-runtime duration>150ms tag.batch_size:>256. If you have a sample trace id from the spike, paste it and I can look. Tempo UI: https://tempo.redwood.internal/search
Lisa: Logs are in k8s; quick command: `kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=gpu-runtime --since=30m` — filter with `grep KVCache` if you want evictions. Also the per-pod memory annotation shows `gpu_memory_total` in the metrics panel.
Alex: thanks — any tips for where batch-size is sampled? The batch hist looks aggregated but I need per-model breakdown to see if one model is batching poorly.
Priya: panel 9 has a breakdown toggle (group by model_id). If it's not in your view hit the dropdown -> group by -> model_id. If you want a raw timeseries query (PromQL): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_batch_size_buckets[5m])) by (le, model_id))` — returns p95 batch size per model.
Jamal: if you suspect KV cache evictions, check `kvcache_evictions_total{pool=~".*"}` and `kvcache_hit_ratio`. Also look at `kv_cache_kvstore_memory_bytes` per-pool.
Lisa: alert tuning lives in infra repo: `infra/monitoring/prometheus/rules/gpu.rules`. Rule names to inspect: `GPU_High_SM_Mem`, `GPU_KVCache_Evictions_High`, `GPU_Batch_Size_Skew`. If you want I can open a PR with adjusted thresholds for the model in question.
ops-bot: Scheduled: dashboard refresh deploy to include model_id breakdown at 03:00 UTC (runbook updated).
Alex: perfect — @Priya can you drop the three panel links (SM%, KV, batch hist) into the incident runbook? I'll attach a trace id if I find one.
Priya: on it, will update runbook and add suggested prom thresholds.
Jamal: ping me if you need me to correlate traces/logs, I can join async.
Alex: thanks all :raised_hands:
